text: VPN setup guide. Install the company VPN client from the software portal, then sign in with SSO. If the client drops every few minutes, switch the protocol to WireGuard in settings and reconnect.

Expense reimbursement policy. File expenses within 30 days of the trip. Meals are capped at $75 per day domestic and $120 international. Attach itemized receipts; credit card statements alone are not enough.
New-hire onboarding checklist. Day one: laptop pickup, badge photo, and benefits enrollment. Day two: team intros and repo access requests. Finish the security training before the end of week one.

Incident response runbook. Page the on-call engineer first, then open a war room channel. Declare severity within 15 minutes. The incident commander owns the timeline doc until the postmortem is filed.

Staging environment overview. Staging mirrors production with anonymized data refreshed nightly. Deployments to staging go out every Thursday. Do not run load tests against staging without telling the platform team.

Deploy pipeline docs. Merges to the release branch kick off the canary deploy automatically. Watch the error budget dashboard for 30 minutes after a canary starts. Roll back with the one-click button if errors spike.
